provenance_note: Every solver carries a run_dir with levels_completed_delta>0. No exceptions.

solvers.applies_when: a selectable source actor and a target port/sink exist
solvers.mechanic: liquid flows only when the source actor is edge-aligned with its sink
solvers.name: PORTBAND_EDGE_LOCK_ALIGN
solvers.procedure: select source; issue axis-ordered PortBand lineup moves toward the target port (value_score~0.82, centered_dual_port_projection) until edge-locked

solvers.applies_when: a locked source must close remaining distance to its sink along one axis
solvers.mechanic: monotone distance descent finishes the alignment a lineup-lock leaves open
solvers.name: FLOW_DIRECTION_DESCENT
solvers.procedure: repeat move toward sink while distance_reduced (value_score~0.69); stop when distance_delta==0

solvers.mechanic: each source is locked to its own sink before any flow is committed
solvers.name: MULTI_SOURCE_GOAL_ADJACENCY
solvers.procedure: least-steps plan over independent source->target pairs (value_score~0.75)

solvers.applies_when: all source actors are edge-locked to their sinks
solvers.mechanic: activate_flow while fully aligned commits the pour and completes the level (negative control: identical activate_flow at idx 5 did NOT win -- only alignment differed)
solvers.name: ACTIVATE_FLOW_ON_FULL_ALIGNMENT
solvers.procedure: issue activate_flow (ACTION5) ONLY when board alignment is complete

wanted_mechanics.name: STABLE_MULTI_SOURCE_RELAY_LOCK
procedure: LOCK: when a multi_object_goal_adjacency_plan candidate scores >=0.85, COMMIT to it and pin the (source,target) pair as the active relay leg.

HOLD: while the active leg is still closing distance, SUPPRESS switching to any other candidate_kind (anti-thrash). Release only when the leg's source is edge-locked (portband_score==1.0) or stuck (2 consecutive no-progress on this leg).
ADVANCE: on lock-complete, move to the next unlocked source->sink leg; repeat LOCK/HOLD.
DEFER: hard-gate activate_flow until ALL legs are locked; the bare 0.48 unknown_action_family activate_flow probe must NOT win while any leg is unlocked.
wanted_mechanics.want: commit to one source->target edge-lock at a time, suppress re-selection thrash, and defer activate_flow until ALL sources are locked
